MuchTip · Design spec v5 · final · for implementation

Every screen and state in one file

This is the approved design. Match its layout, copy, spacing, colours, type and states exactly. Balances, X IDs, transaction hashes, handles and times are examples only. The app reads real values from wagmi, the TipEscrow contract, Supabase (resolve, sign-claim) and feed(). Never ship example values as live data. The one exception is the hero phones (K1): they are a marketing illustration with sample accounts and are labelled as such.

Structure

  • Marketing site at /: hero with persona phones, activity, how it works with the receipt ticket, get started, the 2014 story, for creators, FAQ, footer
  • Product app at /app with four tabs: Send, Claim (/app/claim), My tips (/app/tips), Activity (/app/activity)
  • Under 640px the app uses the phone layout (P1–P4) with a bottom tab bar
  • Every "Open app" link goes to /app

Type (taken from the MultiHopper reference site)

  • Inter for all text (400, 500, 600, 700). IBM Plex Mono for numbers, hashes, addresses and labels (400, 500, 600)
  • Hero h1: Inter 500, line-height 1.04, letter-spacing −0.055em
  • h2: Inter 700 · h3: Inter 600 · all headings letter-spacing −0.045em, text-wrap: balance
  • Eyebrow labels: IBM Plex Mono 500, 13px (12px under 640px), letter-spacing 0.1em, uppercase
  • Lead paragraph: Inter 400, 18px (17px under 640px), line-height 1.7 · buttons: Inter 600, 15px
  • Remove every other font (Geist, Schibsted Grotesk, JetBrains Mono). No em dashes in copy

Colour

  • Gold #F2B824: hero, footer, primary actions
  • Ink #0E0F14: text, dark cards, receipt ticket
  • Paper #FAFAF7 (site), #F4F3EE (app), stage #F3F2EE
  • Pastel tiles (waiting, refund, claimed, people, info)
  • Gold-ink #8A6400 links on light · success error warning

Components

  • Pill buttons (radius 999) in the hero, phones and receipt; app buttons radius 10–12px
  • Receipt ticket: ink card radius 28, notches + dashed perforation, Sent → Held → Claimed timeline, network + tx, "Tell them on X" + "Copy link"
  • Phone frame: light bezel 9px, radius 54/45, status bar with island
  • Tap targets 44px on phones; motion short and functional, off under reduced motion

Build notes

Hero persona switcher

  • State: persona 0 Ada, 1 Leo (default), 2 Mia
  • Three phones always mounted, absolutely positioned from the centre. Centre: translateX(-50%). Right: +372px, translateY(52px), scale(.9). Left: the same with −372px
  • Slot = (i − persona + 3) % 3: 0 centre, 1 right, 2 left. Transition transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)
  • Clicking a side phone or a tab selects it. Tabs are role=tab with aria-selected
  • Under 860px side phones hidden; under 640px role labels hidden
  • Stage row 560px tall, overflow hidden, with a fade at the bottom

PhoneScreen component

  • One React component taking persona and banner. Copy and numbers for the three personas are fixed, as in K1
  • Pure presentation: no wallet, no fetches
  • Floating bottom nav: the active icon depends on the persona (Ada Send, Leo Claim, Mia My tips)

Receipt ticket

  • One ReceiptTicket component used on the landing (H1) and as the draft preview on Send (A1)
  • Props: amount, to, from, status (draft, waiting, claimed, refunded), sentAt, refundAt, txHash, note
  • The notch circles must match the background behind the card (#FFFFFF on landing, #F4F3EE in the app)
  • In the app, "Tell them on X" opens an X intent with the receipt link; the explorer link uses the real tx hash

Still to confirm

  • The tip page domain shown as muchtip.xyz is a placeholder. Use the real deployed origin
  • The refund window says 10 minutes (testnet value); read it from refundDelay() on the contract
  • The minimum tip says 5 DOGE; read it from minTip()
